deviations.details: The initial two M2 attempts used generated IDs instead of the M0-frozen IDs. Both terminal outcomes were retained without retry. All subsequent runs used M0-frozen IDs.
The selected detector pointer differed from its corrected M1 revision before M2. M2 explicitly used the frozen corrected M1 revision; it did not change the pointer.
